decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0015-env-reset-amp, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's OS 1.74 port sites (two 2-byte code sites at 0x400bcf8a and 0x400ef8d6, and 6 stock bytes at 0x40109b70 replaced by jmp env_reset_amp_attack) became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release; the two byte sites keep their new bytes (7403, 4e71) as bytes sites of kind code.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
